name: Tokio Wataru
source:
[url=/c6258]Ethan[/url]'s Father. At his son's 17th birthday, both he and his wife disappeared. He investigated the death of one of his classmate's mother, Mary Onegin.

Timothy's Japanese is a homonym for "to cross time".
